deployment_target: Raspberry Pi via systemd (parent monolith). No Dockerfile or container artefacts — see DEPLOYMENT.md and the project-level rejection history (2026-03-18) for the deliberate decision against containerised deployment.

requirement_compliance.title: Rule evaluation tick aligned to parent 5 s metrics cadence
requirement_compliance.evidence: fr_coverage: 5 passing, 0 failing, 0 skipped. Engine evaluates inline on the SSE broadcast loop (server/sse.go::buildSSEPayloadWithOptions calls Service.evalTick). TC-IE-001h asserts the eval fires per tick; TC-IE-001f asserts no eval when no snapshot is available; TC-IE-001e covers the 100-tick budget. Technical debt: engine is not subscribed to a dedicated metrics.Collector tick channel — that contract does not exist; the SSE-driven path satisfies AC-001 ('verdict-set published within 5 s') but is the substitution path.

requirement_compliance.title: Rule schema (id, title, condition, severity, verdict, recommendation, links)
requirement_compliance.evidence: fr_coverage: 4 passing, 0 failing, 0 skipped. Strict JSON-schema decoder at internal/insights/rules/rules.go enforces every required field; severity bound to {info,warn,critical} via SQLite CHECK constraint and Go validator. TC-IE-002h (well-formed loads), TC-IE-002f (missing required field rejected), TC-IE-002e (invalid severity rejected) all green. Zero declared technical debt for this FR. TC-IE-013f added for AC-040-003: duplicate rule ids: the first occurrence loads and the second is logged as duplicate-rule-id, isolated from the unrelated rejections TC-IE-002e bundles. No production code changed — the behaviour already existed and was untested.

requirement_compliance.title: Boolean condition language with sustained-window operators
requirement_compliance.evidence: fr_coverage: 4 passing, 0 failing, 0 skipped. internal/insights/lang implements the JSON expression grammar (var/const/eq/ne/gt/gte/lt/lte/and/or/not/sustained). Missing var → false + log-once is enforced at AST-eval time. TC-IE-003h/f/e all green. Technical debt: swap_pct, lan_device_offline_count, and loss_pct telemetry variables are not yet projected from any existing collector — the SSE adapter only populates cpu_pct, ram_pct, temp_c, disk_root_pct, services_failed, containers_failed, wan_gateway_ok, wan_cloudflare_ok. Memory-pressure / sustained-packet-loss / lan-empty rules degrade gracefully (never fire) per AC-002 until those vars are wired. TC-IE-014f added for AC-041-003: a condition over an absent variable resolves false rather than erroring, emitting one skipped-missing-var line per process. No production code changed — the behaviour already existed and was untested.

requirement_compliance.title: Verdict lifecycle — appear within one tick, disappear within one tick
requirement_compliance.evidence: fr_coverage: 3 passing, 0 failing, 0 skipped. Service.evalTick computes the active set per tick and the SSE adapter emits the new fragment only when it differs from the prior set. TC-IE-004h (false→true within next tick), TC-IE-004f (true→false within next tick), TC-IE-004e (rule disabled mid-flight clears verdict immediately). Zero declared technical debt for this FR.

requirement_compliance.title: SSE delivery of verdicts on the existing dashboard channel
requirement_compliance.evidence: fr_coverage: 5 passing, 0 failing, 0 skipped. New SSE event 'verdicts' carries the rendered HTML fragment. server/sse.go emits it only when the active set changes since the prior broadcast (FR-043 AC-002 — bandwidth budget). TC-IE-005h/f/e plus the API auth pair (TC-IE-012h/f) all green. Zero declared technical debt for this FR.

requirement_compliance.title: Dashboard 'Operational indicators' section rendering
requirement_compliance.evidence: fr_coverage: 4 passing, 0 failing, 0 skipped. web/templates/partials/sse-verdicts.html renders the live fragment with severity-ordered cards and an empty-state line ('All operational indicators clear'). TC-IE-006h/f/e all green via HTTP-fragment integration tests. Technical debt declared: no headless-browser DOM tests (project has no chromedp/Playwright); axe-core contrast scan deferred (NFR-020) — same reason. TC-IE-015h added for AC-044-002: within a severity, verdicts order by first_emitted_at descending — asserted over 20 reads because Active() ranges a map, so a dropped tie-break would still order correctly on roughly half of single reads. No production code changed — the behaviour already existed and was untested.

requirement_compliance.title: Rule enable/disable persistence in SQLite
requirement_compliance.evidence: fr_coverage: 4 passing, 0 failing, 0 skipped. internal/insights/store/store.go owns reads/writes for the rules table; LoadBundled upserts on first boot and preserves user-modified enabled flags on subsequent boots. No delete API for bundled rules in v1 (only disable). TC-IE-007h (fresh DB seeds 10), TC-IE-007f (disable survives re-open), TC-IE-007e (schema idempotent). Zero declared technical debt for this FR. TC-IE-016f added for AC-045-003: an orphan RuleState row survives, does not fail startup, and never reaches evaluation, while a real rule still fires alongside it. No production code changed — the behaviour already existed and was untested.

requirement_compliance.title: Verdict de-duplication / hysteresis (SHOULD)
requirement_compliance.evidence: fr_coverage: 4 passing, 0 failing, 0 skipped. Hysteresis algorithm: rule_state.transitions_in_window counts state changes inside a sliding 10 s window; if ≥5, the engine holds the last stable value until the window clears. TC-IE-008h (5+ transitions in 10 s → hold), TC-IE-008f (clean run → no hold), TC-IE-008e (state survives one tick miss). Zero declared technical debt. TC-IE-017f added for AC-046-002: the rule-flapping line is emitted once per window carrying rule_id and transition_count, with the count matching the FlapThreshold crossing that engaged the hold. No production code changed — the behaviour already existed and was untested.

requirement_compliance.title: Bootstrap rule set v1 — 10 hand-curated rules
requirement_compliance.evidence: fr_coverage: 4 passing, 0 failing, 0 skipped. internal/insights/rules/bundled.json ships exactly 10 rules covering thermal, memory pressure, WAN/LAN disambiguation, disk near-full, disk critical, container/service failed, sustained packet loss, temp warning, LAN empty. TC-IE-009h (thermal-throttling AC), TC-IE-009f (WAN-down-isp AC), TC-IE-009e (1-hour idle Pi → zero verdicts). Technical debt: severity distribution differs from spec example (3 critical / 5 warn / 2 info vs example 5/4/1) — operationally appropriate; FR-047 AC-006 only requires each rule to have an assigned severity, not a specific count. TC-IE-018h added for AC-047-004: wan_gateway_ok true with wan_cloudflare_ok false held over two consecutive ticks yields the WAN/LAN verdict at severity warn. No production code changed — the behaviour already existed and was untested.

requirement_compliance.title: Performance / Resource Budget
requirement_compliance.evidence: TC-IE-001e covers the per-tick budget (100 ticks under wall-clock budget); TC-IE-011e uses testing.AllocsPerRun to assert zero allocations against the precompiled rule closure once warm. Technical debt: 24-hour Pi soak / pprof allocation profile not executed in this Phase 4 session — operator deployment validation.

requirement_compliance.title: Persistence / Storage — reuse parent SQLite + backup
requirement_compliance.evidence: Schema appended to internal/database/sqlite.go's existing schema constant — picked up by parent migration path on first start. The rules and rule_state tables are automatically captured by the parent's existing Backup() (VACUUM INTO).

requirement_compliance.title: Observability — structured logs, evaluation latency
requirement_compliance.evidence: Engine logs rule load failures + missing-var warnings (once per rule per process lifetime to avoid log spam). Service exposes evaluation duration via Status() for future wiring into the parent's metrics surface.

requirement_compliance.title: Security — bundled-only rules in v1
requirement_compliance.evidence: Rule definitions ship as a go:embed bundled.json; no runtime file read, no user-supplied rule input. /api/insights/verdicts is GET-only behind parent FR-007 auth (TC-IE-012f). Future custom-rules path is explicitly v2 / out of scope.

requirement_compliance.title: UX / Accessibility
requirement_compliance.evidence: Severity badges reuse parent FR-009 design tokens (bg-danger, text-yellow-400, text-blue-400). Each verdict card renders the severity as an explicit text label so colour is not the sole communicator (NFR-020 AC-003). Technical debt: axe-core / Lighthouse contrast audit deferred — same headless-browser-stack reason as FR-044.

requirement_compliance.title: Boundary / Notification Isolation — verdicts ≠ alerts
requirement_compliance.evidence: Architectural boundary enforced by TC-IE-010e: 'go list -deps github.com/.../internal/insights/...' MUST NOT include any package under internal/alerts or internal/notify. Verified at build time as part of go test ./internal/insights/... — boundary check would fail the test if violated. Confirmed empty: 'go list -deps ./internal/insights/... | grep -E alerts|notify' returns nothing on the current tree.

technical_debt_inherited.substitution: Bundled severity distribution differs from the spec example (FR-047 AC-006 example: 5 critical / 4 warn / 1 info). Implemented as 3 critical / 5 warn / 2 info — closer to the actual operational expectations: container_failed and temp_warning are info because container restarts and a 70 °C temperature are not action-now events; service_failed and disk_critical remain critical.
technical_debt_inherited.reason: The AC explicitly says 'each rule has a severity assigned' — the count is informational. Operational behaviour matches the AC: thermal/disk-critical/service-failed are critical; warnings are recoverable; info is observational.

technical_debt_inherited.substitution: Engine evaluation is driven inline by the existing SSE broadcast loop (server/sse.go::buildSSEPayloadWithOptions calls evalInsightsTick), not by a dedicated subscription channel from metrics.Collector. Service.Start(ctx, tickC, snapFn) is exposed for future use but unused in v1 wiring.
technical_debt_inherited.reason: metrics.Collector does not currently expose a tick channel or callback. Adding one would touch a parent contract for one downstream consumer; reusing the SSE broker tick (which already runs at sseInterval, defaulting to the same 5 s cadence) satisfies FR-039 AC-001 ('verdict-set published within 5 s') without changing the collector API.

technical_debt_inherited.substitution: swap_pct, lan_device_offline_count, and loss_pct telemetry variables are not yet projected from any existing collector — the SSE adapter (server/sse.go::evalInsightsTick) only populates cpu_pct, ram_pct, temp_c, disk_root_pct, services_failed, containers_failed, wan_gateway_ok, wan_cloudflare_ok. The memory_pressure / sustained_packet_loss / lan_offline_burst rules therefore stay quiet in production until those variables are wired. FR-041 AC-002 — 'missing var resolves to false, never error' — is preserved by the lang package; the rules degrade gracefully.
technical_debt_inherited.reason: Bringing in the WAN packet-loss and LAN-devices feeds is a separate integration step. The rule definitions ship now; the dashboard surface ships now; the data-source wiring is incremental and does not require a v2 binary.
